instruction: Show the bookmarks bar, create a folder named "Test" on the bar, and add a bookmark inside it named "Example" pointing to https://example.com.

verification.condition: Open chrome://bookmarks and verify there is a folder titled "Test" containing a bookmark titled "Example" whose URL is "https://example.com/"
verification.expected_result: Bookmark folder "Test" exists with child bookmark "Example" -> https://example.com/
